response.years: 1992-2017 where both N[t-1] and N[t] exist
response.zero_counts: retained via log1p; no pseudo-count beyond +1 transform

source.title: Seasonal sea ice indices ... 1979/80 to 2023/24 ice seasons

regional_predictor.alignment: For breeding census year t, use the complete sea-ice season ending in calendar year t (the preceding winter relative to the November census). Never use a sea-ice season that extends beyond census year t.
regional_predictor.standardization: z-score using training years within each leave-one-year-out fold
regional_predictor.primary_direction: longer preceding sea-ice duration predicts higher / less-negative Adelie annual growth

transport_mirror.note: transport mirror only; scientific source remains EDI knb-lter-pal.151.9 entity 13bb2b05f1e930574150d9cd8ab04b8a

island_physical_prior.source: Fraser et al. 2013, A Nonmarine Source of Variability in Adelie Penguin Demography, Oceanography 26(3)
island_physical_prior.variable: suboptimal breeding habitat percent derived from wind-oriented hillshade / southwest-aspect snow-retention proxy
island_physical_prior.epistemic_status: prior-known published predictor, not fresh discovery
island_physical_prior.use: center and scale across the five islands; use only as an interaction modifier of the regional sea-ice predictor in the primary panel model
island_physical_prior.prohibited_claim: Do not present the previously published habitat-decline association as an independent replication.

validation.scheme: leave-one-calendar-year-out; all five island rows for a held-out year are excluded together
validation.metric: mean squared error on annual growth
validation.primary_quantity: MSE(M0) - MSE(M1), positive means sea ice improves year transfer
validation.secondary_quantity: MSE(M1) - MSE(M2), positive means the habitat interaction improves year transfer

descriptive_coefficients.regional_beta: M1 full-data coefficient for standardized sea-ice duration
descriptive_coefficients.interaction_beta: M2 full-data coefficient for seaice x habitat
descriptive_coefficients.uncertainty: year-cluster bootstrap with 10000 resamples and fixed seed 20260927; descriptive because only 26 annual clusters

decision_rules.regional_support: primary LOYO MSE gain > 0 AND full-data regional beta > 0
decision_rules.habitat_moderation_support: secondary LOYO MSE gain > 0; interaction sign is reported but no directional sign was predeclared
decision_rules.no_support: nonpositive predictive gain for the corresponding added term

interpretation_boundaries: Predictive support for sea-ice duration is not by itself causal identification.
The sea-ice predictor is common to all five islands and therefore explains regional annual variation, not island identity.
The habitat metric is previously published and partly motivated by historical population trends; only its moderation of year-to-year sea-ice response is treated as the new test here.
Do not infer competition from residual island heterogeneity.
Post-extinction Litchfield zeros are retained for population-state prediction but sensitivity analyses must report results excluding years after first persistent zero.
sensitivity_analyses: repeat M0/M1/M2 excluding Litchfield years after its first persistent zero
repeat using actual ice days instead of season duration as a non-primary robustness check
repeat primary M1 on four persistently extant islands CHR,COR,HUM,TOR
next_gate: Only after this result is frozen may precipitation/snow metrics or heterospecific abundance be added as additional mechanism predictors.
